:::{#exm-alt-cov}
#### Covariance of a binary exposure and outcome

For the joint PMF in @exm-cond-variance,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\E{XY} &= \P(X = 1, Y = 1) \\
&= 0.4,
\end{aligned}
$$

$\E{X} = 0.5$, and $\E{Y} = 0.7$, so:

$$
\ba
\Cov{X,Y}
&= \E{XY} - \E{X}\E{Y}
&& \text{(alternative formula for covariance)} \\
&= 0.4 - 0.5 \cd 0.7
&& \text{(substitute)} \\
&= 0.05
&& \text{(evaluate)}
\ea
$$

:::
